_help: Act 1, Freddie Mallory's office: he's gone, leaving debts. Searching his desk finds his note (freddie_note: he went to Alexandria), which you can use or keep (Act 7: Freddie as an informant). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

start.speaker: landlady
start.line: Mr. Mallory? Gone. Three days ago, in the night, with two suitcases and four months of my rent.

menu.speaker: landlady
menu.line: And you are? Another one he owes?

choices.label: Say he owes you
choices.line: He owes me for a job. A big one.

choices.label: Ask who else came
choices.line: Has anyone else come asking for him?

owes.speaker: landlady
owes.line: Him owe you? Then get in line, effendi. The line goes down the stairs.

search.speaker: freddie
search.line: 'Gone to Alex till it blows over. Don't tell Finch. Sorry, old man. F.'

others.speaker: landlady
others.line: Mr. Finch, the moneylender, and his big one, Musa. Every day. They will be back. Probably they are on the stairs now.

bye.speaker: landlady
bye.line: If you find him, tell him the rent is still four months.
